title: Open cones scale linearly under a 1-homogeneous measure (parent step 2)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P such that μ(λW) = λ·μ(W) for every λ > 0 and every open W ⊆ ℝ^P, where λW := {λx : x ∈ W}. Let K ⊆ ℝ^P be an open set such that cx ∈ K whenever c > 0 and x ∈ K. Then for every r > 0, μ(K ∩ B_r(0)) = r·μ(K ∩ B_1(0)), where B_r(0) := {y ∈ ℝ^P : |y| < r}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ W) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen K → (∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∀ x ∈ K, c • x ∈ K) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μ (K ∩ ball 0 r) = ENNReal.ofReal r * μ (K ∩ ball 0 1)
